bullets.title: The Persuasive Power of the Wolf Lady
bullets.note: (The New Yorker).** This is a page-turning read and simply outstanding. I’m already planning on rereading it to study the lessons it contains. Amazing characters and beautiful prose.

bullets.section: Fascinating experiment I’d love to try —
bullets.title: An experimental study of a virtual reality counselling paradigm using embodied self-dialogue
bullets.note: This study was sent to me by [Kevin Kelly](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/wwt2hghkewg7r9/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDE0LzA4LzI5L2tldmluLWtlbGx5Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWNvbnZlcnRraXQmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj01YmY=), and as he put it, “Use virtual reality to swap bodies and give yourself advice. Weird, but early experiments suggest it works.” Kevin hasn’t tried it and simply forwarded it to me, but I’d love to try it myself. Does anyone know how I might do that? Please [let me know on Twitter](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/06cwh9h93dzemo/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS90ZmVycmlzcw==) using @tferriss and #timvr if so.

bullets.section: Email policy I’m still using and benefiting from —
bullets.title: Five.sentenc.es
bullets.note: “Five.sentenc.es is a personal policy that all email responses regardless of recipient or subject will be five sentences or less. It’s that simple.” Here is an example text to place in your signature: “Q: Why is this email five sentences or less? A: [http://five.sentenc.es](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/l0aehmhn83r2on/aHR0cDovL2ZpdmUuc2VudGVuYy5lcw==).” I discovered this ages ago in [a guest post](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/eebph7hl804vkw/aHR0cHM6Ly90aW0uYmxvZy8yMDA4LzAxLzA5LzEwLXN0ZXBzLXRvLWJlY29tZS1hbi1lbWFpbC1uaW5qYS8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jb252ZXJ0a2l0JnV0bV9tZWRpdW09Y29udmVydGtpdCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249NWJm) from [Leo Babauta](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/oehkhqh62ro947/aHR0cHM6Ly96ZW5oYWJpdHMubmV0Lw==). As he wrote, “I limit myself to five sentences for each reply (at the maximum — many replies are even shorter). That forces me to be concise, to choose only the essentials of what I want to say, and limits the time I spend replying to email. Keep them short, but powerful.”

bullets.title: Washington Irving
bullets.note: , an American short story writer, essayist, biographer, historian, and diplomat of the early nineteenth century. He is best known for his short stories "Rip Van Winkle" (1819) and "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow" (1820), both of which appear in his collection [_The Sketch Book of Geoffrey Crayon, Gent_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/6eieh8h5m7orpp/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9MZWdlbmQtU2xlZXB5LUhvbGxvdy1PdGhlci1TdG9yaWVzL2RwLzAzNzU3NTcyMVgv). His historical works include biographies of Oliver Goldsmith, Islamic prophet Muhammad, and George Washington, as well as several histories of fifteenth-century Spain that deal with subjects such as Alhambra, Christopher Columbus, and the Moors. I’m also reading [_The Sketch Book_](https://el2.convertkit-mail.com/c/gku0l36gga5h3z0oda4/klfmh6h5klmw88/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYW1hem9uLmNvbS9MZWdlbmQtU2xlZXB5LUhvbGxvdy1PdGhlci1TdG9yaWVzL2RwLzAzNzU3NTcyMVgv) before bed this week and next.
